_comment: Curated map of HPD marketing agents -> the page where they post AVAILABLE re-rentals.
Why this is hand-curated and not scraped: HPD's PQL lists a corporate homepage, which is
almost never the listings page (Tax Solute is listed as taxsolute.com; their actual re-rental
board is a Google Site on affordablelivingnyc.com). Link-crawling misses pages that aren't
linked from the homepage (TF Cornerstone), and URL-pattern probing produces false positives
on sites that soft-404 into their About page (diamondminere.com, mickigarciarealty.com and
urbanecospaces.com all return 200 for /about/affordable-re-rentals and render 'About Us').
Every URL below was opened in a real browser and confirmed by page title + content.
units_seen = units were actually posted on the check date. false means the page is real and
is where they post, but nothing was listed at that moment - which is the normal state.

excluded._comment: Verified and deliberately left out — recording these so nobody re-adds them.
excluded.Places.NYC LLC: places.nyc/units is market-rate luxury ($6,500 no-fee), not affordable
excluded.K&R Realty Management Inc: gonofee.com is a market-rate no-fee brokerage
excluded.About Real Estate NY: /rentals shows RENTED PROPERTIES — a past-deals archive, not live listings
excluded.Rentability: HPD-listed domain is parked (redirects to search-domainparking.com)
excluded.B3 Compliance Solutions: compliance consultancy site, no renter listings (verified 2026-08-10)
excluded.Belmont Arthur Avenue LDC: program + senior-housing info pages only, no unit board
corporate LIHTC/property-management site, no listings page
excluded.Housing Line Inc: B2B administering agent, no renter-facing listings
excluded.Lemle & Wolff, Inc: posts the current housing lottery only, no re-rentals
excluded.Regtime: B2B software brand; same operator as MGNY (already listed), listings live there
excluded.Settlement Housing Fund: corporate site; the /marketing-leasing/ page has no listings
referral-based supportive housing, no public listings
excluded.Westhab: Westchester supportive-housing nonprofit, no NYC unit board
excluded.Reside Affordable Inc: HPD-listed domain dead - DNS; operator's board is Reside New York's Open Market page
excluded.Grenadier Realty Management: HPD-listed domain parked at sedo; grenadierrealty.com also dead (checked 2026-08-10)

Affordable for NY.title: Outside Market / Re-rentals
Affordable for NY.note: Filterable board with rent + household size per unit.

iAfford NY.title: Outside Market / Re-rentals

The Wavecrest Management Team Ltd..note: Application portal for their LAMP / HDC / LIHTC developments.

Tax Solute Consulting.title: Affordable Living NYC
Tax Solute Consulting.note: First-come, first-served. Separate domain from their HPD-listed site.

K&G Upright Consulting, Inc..title: Current Vacancies
K&G Upright Consulting, Inc..note: Income-restricted rent-stabilized lease-ups (Verdant Fort Greene). No per-unit prices; downloadable application.

Langsam Property Services Corp.title: Affordable Rental Opportunities
Langsam Property Services Corp.note: AMI-banded units with stated rents; apply by email. First-come style.

MNS.title: Affordable Units
MNS.note: Filterable availability table with unit-level rents across their affordable buildings.

Reside New York LLC.title: Open Market
Reside New York LLC.note: Open-market (non-lottery) re-rentals with unit-level rents. Their /listings/ 404s and /my-properties/ throws a WP error - this taxonomy URL is the live board. Same operator as the dead Reside Affordable Inc domain.

Phipps Houses.title: Housing Opportunities
Phipps Houses.note: Directory of 42 buildings with waitlist/vacancy applications (e.g. Rockaway Village). Applications, not a priced unit board.

Bronx Pro Group LLC.title: Apartments
Bronx Pro Group LLC.note: Waitlist applications; two senior buildings marked Available (rent = 30% of income, HPD PBV S8).

Breaking Ground.title: Need Housing?
Breaking Ground.note: Building browser filterable by which waitlists are currently open; supportive/affordable, PDF applications.

Highbridge Community Development Corpora.title: Apply
Highbridge Community Development Corpora.note: General application by mail for their Bronx portfolio; no unit board.
